What to record: Trades, alternates, exclusions, units and deliverables. Every vendor receives the same scope.
File list, revisions, specifications and addenda. The test can be repeated from these files.
Sheet-by-sheet read, excluded and unreadable statuses. Every submitted document is accounted for.
Plan, schedule and detail discrepancy log. No silent interpretation of unresolved scope.
Reference items, units and per-type tolerance. Measures are defined before seeing results.
Location or calculation for every reviewed quantity. Unsupported items and duplicates are recorded.
Required items reconciled to estimate by trade. Omissions remain visible.
Open questions, exclusions and responsible owner. Bid-blocking items are resolved before submission.
Source, date, market, unit and material match. Assumptions differ visibly from supplier quotes.
Unpriced lines and excluded work register. Unknown values are never treated as zero.
Vendor charge, turnaround, human review and corrections. Automation and human effort are reported separately.
Versioned export and named estimator signoff. The accountable reviewer accepts the bid scope.
